name: Kiribati

fees.name: Visitor Visa (tourism / visiting family or friends)
fees.validity: single-entry usually up to 3 months; multiple-entry up to 6 months
fees.applies: nationalities not covered by the Immigration Entry and Visa Exemption Order 2023
fees.notes: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs & Immigration does not publish a visa fee schedule online. The official Visitor Visa application form only says to pay the 'appropriate fee' and to contact visaofficer@mfa.gov.ki for payment details. Amount left null rather than estimated.

fees.name: Visitor Visa (business purpose)
fees.notes: Business visits use the same Visitor Visa form with additional evidence of employment/business. Fee not published; contact visaofficer@mfa.gov.ki.

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.notes: Transit Visa exists as a category on the official MFA visa page; fee not published online.

free_visa_notes: Kiribati is visa-free for the vast majority of travellers: under the Immigration Entry and Visa Exemption Order 2023, citizens of roughly 190 countries and territories (including USA, UK, Canada, all EU states, Australia, New Zealand, India and China) may enter without a visa for up to 1 month, capped at 90 days of stay within any 12-month period. Only the small remainder of nationalities need a visa in advance; there is no e-visa, eTA or visa-on-arrival scheme, and applications are handled directly by the Immigration Division (visaofficer@mfa.gov.ki) with no VFS/TLS/BLS outsourcing. Fee amounts are not published on any official source, so they are recorded as null.
